text:
The contract is a Form-native Qwen provider contract. It reads the expected provider from the
`expected.json` file, copies it into the `config.json` file and preserves the remote and expected
files. The file is not writable.

```text
./fkwu --src bootstrap/contract/expected-provider.fk
./fkwu --.src form/form-stdlib/expected-file.fk
```

The band returns the same file with the same id, path, and text. The band does not
write the file.
